# Ashmita Vinyls - Complete Overview

> India's premier manufacturer and supplier of industrial PVC strip curtains, polar freezer grade vinyl rolls, anti-static PVC curtains, and stainless steel hanging systems.

## Products & Solutions
Ashmita Vinyls manufactures and imports high-performance industrial PVC strip curtains, polar freezer curtains (-40°C), anti-insect amber curtains, welding screens, and stainless steel suspension brackets.

### PVC Strip Curtain Rolls
- Standard Clear PVC Strip Curtain: 200mm x 2mm, 300mm x 3mm for warehouse partitions and cleanrooms.
- Polar Grade PVC Strip Curtain: Retains flexibility down to -40°C for cold storage and deep freezers.
- Ribbed PVC Strip Curtain: Double-ribbed profile resists scratching from forklifts and heavy pallets.
- Anti-Static PVC Curtain: ESD protection for electronics and clean manufacturing zones.

### Hardware & Suspension Systems
- Stainless Steel (SS304 / SS202) Hook-on Hanger Tracks: Easy snap-in installation and maintenance.
- Mild Steel Powder-Coated Channels: Heavy-duty industrial sliding and fixed track options.
